Bulletin No: 01 LRW/26/05/15/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 09.30 a.m. on 15 May 2026 valid for the period until 08.30 a.m. 16 May 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-western provinces Galle and Matara
districts.
Take action!
The low-pressure area located
northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist.
This system is expected to move away
from Sri Lanka during the next 36 hours
according to the latest weather analysis
based on May 15th morning.
Very heavy showers about 150mm are
likely at some places in Western,
Sabaragamuwa and North-western
provinces.
Heavy showers above 100mm are likely
at some places in and in Galle and
Matara districts.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
